pron_tip: 'nae', level, like the vowel in 'cat' held long. It sits at the end of a request to soften it.
notes: Not on Wiktionary (404); IPA by agent. Sentence-final softener of a request, heard in Vientiane speech per the owner (CURRICULUM_PATH decision 24).
